postgres_requirements.rationale: A mock never observes a CHECK, an RLS policy, a table ACL, a column COMMENT or a unique index. FIBDB-015/017/018 each declare org-scoped RLS and FIBDB-048 declares four vocabulary CHECKs plus two conditional NOT NULL constraints, none of which the DB-free suite can discharge. SEC-ACL-1 is inherited from B4-MAT-B and is explicitly non-waivable. The hosted-fidelity block is a MODEL of the hosted posture, not a measurement of it - the same disclosure the b3 and b4 harnesses carry.

positive_controls.description: CANONICAL MODEL SHAPE. Ten dimensions D1-D10 each weighing exactly 10%; 46 criteria total, each assigned to exactly one primary dimension; dimension_score = 100 * applicable satisfied / applicable total; global = arithmetic mean of the ten; scale 0-100.
DETERMINISTIC REPRODUCIBILITY. The same governed state yields a byte-identical assessment - same global, same ten dimensional scores, same criterion detail - across repeated computation.

GOVERNED NOT_APPLICABLE SATISFIES. A governed not_applicable satisfies its criterion and remains in BOTH numerator and denominator, and is valid only when established by governed state, decision and rationale on the underlying object.

D8-4 VACUITY, THREE STATES. Stella not executed => satisfied by vacuity; Stella executed with zero high findings => satisfied by vacuity; all high findings disposed => satisfied; at least one undisposed => not satisfied. Automatic and deterministic, never a governed not_applicable.

BANDS. The frozen V-22 copy Initial / Partial / Advanced / High Preparation maps to 0-39 / 40-69 / 70-84 / 85-100 with the numeric cut-offs preserved exactly, and the legacy 'Audit-ready candidate' string appears nowhere.

RUN SNAPSHOT AND VERSION IDENTITY. Each run persists exactly one readiness_assessments row carrying the global score, the ten dimensional scores, the criterion detail and readiness_model_version = SROI_READINESS_MODEL 1.0.0 read from governed_model_registry, with UNIQUE(calculation_run_id) enforced.
AUDIT VERB. readiness_assessment.computed is emitted with the human actor and the run identity.

FIVE ADJUSTMENTS ALWAYS REGISTERED. The candidate register contains deadweight, attribution, displacement, drop_off and duration for every monetizing assignment, INCLUDING when a value is 0 or unchanged from the default. None is omissible.

OTHER MANDATORY CANDIDATE KINDS. Every material structured assumption, every proxy value used to monetize where a reasonable alternative/range/uncertainty exists, and discount_rate_pct as other_quantitative_input all enter the register, built from inputs ACTUALLY USED by the run.

GOVERNED DISPOSITION. A candidate transitions from pending to variation_required or no_additional_variation_required carrying rationale, the human actor and a timestamp, and emits sensitivity_candidate.dispositioned with beforeJson.

SAME DETERMINISTIC ENGINE. A scenario executes runDeterministicCalc with ONLY the declared inputs substituted; re-running the base inputs through the scenario path reproduces the golden base result exactly.

COMPLETENESS SEMANTICS. complete requires zero pending AND at least one valid persisted scenario per variation_required; no_additional_variation_required requires no scenario; a single defensible direction satisfies the requirement without a mirror scenario.
SCENARIO ENVELOPE. Min/max across scenarios is exposed and labelled as a scenario envelope, with the base run preserved as the authoritative result and never overwritten.
COMBINED SCENARIOS. A combined scenario persists combination_description stating what combination it represents and why; one_at_a_time and combined are both accepted.

CERTIFIED INTERNAL ORDER. FIBIU-17's migration is registered before FIBIU-18's in db/migrations/meta/_journal.json and in db/hosted/baseline-manifest.ts BASELINE_ORDER, with the second depending on the first. This is a write serialization, and the control asserts NO product dependency edge between FIBIU-17 and FIBIU-18 exists.

TABLE MATERIALIZATION SENTINEL (successor to the B4-era NEG-B5-1 absence check). db/schema.ts matches readinessAssessments|readiness_assessments, sensitivityCandidates|sensitivity_candidates AND sensitivityScenarios|sensitivity_scenarios - the same three regexes W2-B4's governance test used to assert ABSENT, now asserted PRESENT. Binds tests/w2-b4-governance.test.ts as an explicit B5 host, closing the B5-BLK-1 finding that its old absence assertions would otherwise falsely block B5.

FIBDB-016 STATIC MARKING SENTINEL. Within the same 1200-char sroi_run_reviews schema.ts slice W2-B4's governance test already scoped, readinessScore's presence is preserved (unchanged assertion) AND the slice now matches LEGACY_NON_AUTHORITATIVE - the stage-B doc-comment fibdb016_stage_b_realization.technical_realization requires alongside the real-PG column comment PG-POS-3 measures. Static-source complement to PG-POS-3's runtime pg_description proof, not a duplicate of it - PG-POS-3 measures the SQL COMMENT, this measures the db/schema.ts doc-comment.

REAL POSTGRESQL SAME-TENANT ROUND TRIP. Under the two-tenant fixture, an organization's own analyst can SELECT and INSERT its own rows in all three new tables, and UPDATE a sensitivity_candidates disposition.

REAL POSTGRESQL VOCABULARY AND CONSTRAINTS. Every value of disposition, candidate_kind and scenario_kind is accepted and every non-member rejected; rationale NOT NULL holds in both non-pending states; combined without combination_description is rejected; UNIQUE(calculation_run_id) on readiness_assessments and the per-run candidate uniqueness both hold.

FIBDB-016 STAGE-B MARKING IS PRESENT AND MEASURABLE. The LEGACY_NON_AUTHORITATIVE column comment on sroi_run_reviews.readiness_score is readable from pg_description, and the column itself still exists with its data intact - proving marking without stage-F retirement.

negative_controls.description: MANUAL WRITE STOP. No path writes authoritative readiness from human input: the run-review action schemas reject a readinessScore field, the persist path no longer accepts it, and the manual form input is gone.

COMPOSER DOES NOT READ LEGACY. buildComposerContext no longer selects sroi_run_reviews.readiness_score and emits no readiness value derived from it; the composer authorized-numeric set no longer admits it.
VALIDATOR DOES NOT READ LEGACY. buildValidatorContext no longer selects sroi_run_reviews.readiness_score.

REVIEWER DOES NOT READ LEGACY - BOTH ROUTES. ReviewerRunReviewSummary no longer exposes latestReadinessScore (its own read), AND projectAnalysisState.readinessScore is no longer inherited from the validator base spread. Both routes must be closed; closing one is a partial migration and fails this control.
REVIEWER PROMPT CARRIES NO LEGACY VALUE. The reviewer payload contains no readiness number sourced from sroi_run_reviews, and the promptMention mapping for runReviews.latestReadinessScore is gone.

PORTFOLIO LEGACY LABELLING. lib/portfolios/analytics.ts may still read the manual score, but exposes it only as LEGACY_NON_AUTHORITATIVE; it is never labelled authoritative readiness and never enters the consolidated ratio. The population predicate and the sum/sum formula are unchanged.

MATRIX IS NOT CANONICAL READINESS. No surface substitutes methodology_review_matrix.readiness_score for FIBC-021 readiness. Discriminating proof: given the same item set containing at least one not_applicable, the matrix algorithm (which EXCLUDES it from the denominator) and the FIBC-021 algorithm (which counts it as SATISFIED in both) return DIFFERENT values. Equal results prove one algorithm has supplanted the other.

STELLA AVAILABILITY INVARIANT. No criterion of the 46 resolves by consulting whether Stella is enabled, available or was invoked. Static proof: lib/pipeline/sroi-readiness.ts imports nothing from lib/stella/** and reads no STELLA_* capability flag. Behavioural proof: the same governed state yields an identical score with Stella enabled and disabled.

NO HUMAN OR STELLA POINT INJECTION. No exported path accepts a caller-supplied global_score, dimension score or criterion resolution override; readiness_assessments carries no UPDATE policy so a persisted score cannot be edited after the fact.

READINESS NEVER GATES APPROVAL. Neither the canonical readiness score nor any of its dimensions is pushed into getSroiCalculationReadiness blockingReasons or canCalculate; the 46 pre-existing fixtures stay green unchanged.
NO STAGE-F RETIREMENT. sroi_run_reviews.readiness_score still exists with its historical values; the B5 migrations contain no DROP COLUMN, no rename, no NOT NULL and no read-only trigger against it.

LEGACY UNIFORM MODEL ABSENT. SCENARIO_DELTA_PP, scenarioFilterPct and calculateSroiScenarios appear in no lib/** or app/** path. The W2-B4 byte-pin asserting their presence is inverted into this absence sentinel.

FIBIU-18 SUPERSESSION SENTINEL, PINNED SOURCE. The same read of lib/pipeline/sroi-sensitivity.ts that W2-B4's governance test used to assert MUST match SCENARIO_DELTA_PP now must NOT match it, proving FIBC-022's supersede_not_extend was executed at the exact file the constant lived in. Complements NEG-18-1's whole-tree scan by anchoring the historical B4-era positive assertion this file made - not a duplicate proof method, a narrower one on the same file the audit found still falsely constrained.
PENDING FAILS CLOSED. A run with any pending candidate is never complete, and the resulting SENSITIVITY_INCOMPLETE fact names WHICH candidates are pending rather than a bare boolean.
VARIATION_REQUIRED WITHOUT SCENARIO FAILS CLOSED. A variation_required candidate with zero persisted scenarios leaves the run incomplete.
RATIONALE MANDATORY. A non-pending disposition without rationale is rejected at the service boundary AND by the database CHECK.
BASE RUN NEVER OVERWRITTEN. Recording any scenario leaves the base run's persisted results byte-identical.

NO STATISTICAL CONFIDENCE SEMANTICS. No confidence interval, standard deviation, variance, p-value or probability language appears in the sensitivity service, its schemas or its surfaced copy; min/max is exposed only as a scenario envelope.
NO UNIVERSAL MATERIALITY THRESHOLD. No hardcoded percentage decides material sensitivity; the system computes and displays deltas and the reviewer records the determination.
NO RETROSPECTIVE BACKFILL. No path creates a candidate or a scenario for a pre-model historical run; such runs remain legacy_non_authoritative.
SENSITIVITY_INCOMPLETE IS NOT A CALCULATION BLOCKER. The signal feeds the readiness/issue representation only and never enters blockingReasons or canCalculate; FIBIU-19 composes approval eligibility.
APPROVED-RUN REFUSAL. Registering, dispositioning or recording a scenario against a run that already carries an approved review is refused.

STELLA WRITE BOUNDARY. No FIBIU-17 or FIBIU-18 write path admits a Stella-originated actor; every write authorizes through a human session accessor; the readiness computation is a pure system derivation with no actor parameter; Stella never computes scenario ratios nor determines which scenarios are used.

STAGE-A ONLY. The B5 migrations contain no CREATE TRIGGER, no VALIDATE CONSTRAINT, no NOT VALID, no SECURITY DEFINER and no ENABLE ALWAYS. Every CHECK is plain and immediately validated. Stage-E hardening for FIBDB-017/018/048 is deferred.

B5 DOES NOT MATERIALIZE WAVE 3 OR LATER. No readiness_assessments consumer performs eligibility composition; no FIBIU-19, FIBIU-20, FIBIU-24, FIBIU-26, FIBIU-27 or FIBIU-30 surface is touched; FIBDB-051, FIBDB-030 and FIBDB-052 remain unmaterialized.

CLOSED-WORLD SURFACE HELD. The B5 diff contains no path outside W2_B5_AUTHORITY_v1.0.0.json authorized_future_implementation_surface and touches none of its explicitly_prohibited entries. The gate MUST be invoked with the authority's own enumeration; invoking ods:scope with an allowlist derived from the diff is a vacuous PASS and fails this control.

REAL POSTGRESQL CROSS-TENANT SELECT DENIED. Organization A's role cannot SELECT organization B's rows in readiness_assessments, sensitivity_candidates or sensitivity_scenarios. Each probe carries an own-tenant positive control in the SAME probe so denial is distinguished from zero-rows-by-accident.
REAL POSTGRESQL CROSS-TENANT INSERT DENIED. Organization A's role cannot INSERT a row bound to organization B in any of the three tables.

REAL POSTGRESQL UPDATE SURFACE. Cross-tenant UPDATE of sensitivity_candidates is denied with a real ROW_COUNT of zero under a real role; readiness_assessments and sensitivity_scenarios are proven to carry NO UPDATE policy at all, measured from pg_policies.

NO NEW FUNCTION OR PUBLIC EXECUTE SURFACE. B5 introduces no function and no SECURITY DEFINER surface; that emptiness is PROVEN by measuring pg_proc for B5-owned names, never asserted by silent omission.
NO DELETE PATH. None of the three new tables carries a DELETE policy; a delete attempt under a real tenant role affects zero rows.

HOSTED ACL DISPOSITION PROVEN PER NEW TABLE - REQUIRED, NON-WAIVABLE. For EACH of readiness_assessments, sensitivity_candidates and sensitivity_scenarios, an explicit hosted/runtime ACL disposition consistent with the governed role topology is proven: uellix_writer holds SELECT and INSERT on all three plus UPDATE on sensitivity_candidates only; uellix_auditor holds SELECT on all three; PUBLIC holds nothing; RLS is enabled on all three and the policy counts are exactly 2 / 3 / 2. Absence of proof is a failure, not a default. It may not be waived, deferred or marked non-blocking by the implementation mission.

BASELINE-GROWTH REFRESH COMPLETE. After registering two units, pnpm journal:verify and pnpm baseline:verify both pass at 78 units, pnpm b0:observation:verify reports no divergence from the corpus, pnpm a1:status:verify passes, and the rehearsal artifact records manifestApplied = 78. No KTC identifier is created for any of it.
HISTORICAL PIN UNTOUCHED. scripts/stella-r3-5-pg17-certify.ts still asserts BASELINE_UNITS.length !== 50 - the baseline-growth sweep advanced no historical closure fact.

mutation_controls.description: Restoring a manual readiness write path (re-adding readinessScore to a run-review action schema or the persist path) makes NEG-17-1 FAIL.
Restoring the legacy read in buildComposerContext makes NEG-17-2 FAIL.
Restoring the legacy read in buildValidatorContext makes NEG-17-3 FAIL - and, because the reviewer inherits the base spread, must also make NEG-17-4 FAIL.

Restoring latestReadinessScore in buildRunReviewSummary, or the runReviews.latestReadinessScore prompt mapping, makes NEG-17-4 and NEG-17-5 FAIL. This is the direct mutation control for the reviewer enumeration gap.
Substituting computeReadinessScore (the matrix algorithm) for the FIBC-021 computation, or vice versa, makes NEG-17-7 FAIL on the not_applicable discriminator.
Making any criterion consult Stella availability makes NEG-17-8 FAIL.
Exposing any setter for global_score or a criterion resolution makes NEG-17-9 FAIL.
Changing governed not_applicable to be excluded from the denominator makes POS-17-3 FAIL.
Tying D8-4 to whether Stella was executed rather than to whether findings exist makes POS-17-4 FAIL.
Pushing the readiness score into blockingReasons or canCalculate makes NEG-17-10 FAIL, with the 46 pre-existing fixtures as the detector.
Removing the readinessAssessments, sensitivityCandidates or sensitivityScenarios table declaration from db/schema.ts makes POS-GOV-B4-1 FAIL.
Removing LEGACY_NON_AUTHORITATIVE from the db/schema.ts sroi_run_reviews doc-comment (independently of the real-PG column comment MUT-PG-6 targets) makes POS-GOV-B4-2 FAIL.

Reintroducing the uniform +/-10pp model anywhere in lib/** or app/** makes NEG-18-1 FAIL; reintroducing SCENARIO_DELTA_PP specifically in lib/pipeline/sroi-sensitivity.ts additionally makes NEG-GOV-B4-1 FAIL. One mutation, two independent detectors - no separate mutation control is added for NEG-GOV-B4-1.
Accepting a pending candidate as complete makes NEG-18-2 FAIL.
Omitting any one of the five adjustment dimensions from the register makes POS-18-1 FAIL.
Omitting an adjustment because its value is 0 or unchanged makes POS-18-1 FAIL.
Computing a scenario through any path other than the shared deterministic engine makes POS-18-4 FAIL.
Labelling the scenario envelope as a confidence interval makes NEG-18-6 FAIL.
Dropping the org SELECT policy on any of the three tables is caught: the own-tenant read collapses to zero rows under RLS.
Dropping any of the four FIBDB-048 vocabulary CHECKs lets a non-member value INSERT successfully, which the probe requires and detects.
Dropping the conditional rationale or combination_description NOT NULL CHECK lets an incomplete row INSERT successfully.
Granting uellix_writer an UPDATE on readiness_assessments or sensitivity_scenarios, or adding an UPDATE policy to either, is caught by SEC-N3's pg_policies measurement.

Making calculation_run_id nullable on any of the three tables is caught by an explicit run-binding probe. This closes the semantic coverage gap the W2-B4 closure audit recorded as B4-NB-3, where the equivalent mutation left the entire probe suite green.
Removing the FIBDB-016 LEGACY_NON_AUTHORITATIVE column comment makes PG-POS-3 FAIL, proving the stage-B marking is a measured fact rather than a claim.
Removing any one new B5 server action from tests/database-entrypoint-inventory.json makes the closed-world enumeration test FAIL. This is the direct mutation control for the B3-BLK-A failure class.

Leaving any one of the eleven forced baseline pins at its pre-B5 value makes its host FAIL. The control explicitly includes tests/eval/stella-release/hosted-baseline-gate.ts:403, whose literal is BASELINE_ORDER.length + 1 and contains no occurrence of the pre-growth unit count - a literal-only sweep misses it.

Advancing the R3.5 historical pin scripts/stella-r3-5-pg17-certify.ts BASELINE_UNITS.length !== 50 makes NEG-BASE-2 FAIL, proving the sweep distinguishes a current-state pin from a historical closure fact.
